title: Formal coproduct evaluation preserves homology
statement: For a category C and a formal coproduct X of objects of C, the functor from abelian presheaves on C to abelian groups which takes P to the product of its values on the constituents of X preserves homology of every short complex. The indexing family is arbitrary, including empty.

source.place: Step 2, products of complexes of abelian groups have the product of their cohomologies

proof.text: Restrict presheaves to the discrete category of constituents of X. Restriction preserves finite limits and colimits, computed objectwise. The product-to-limit isomorphism Pi.isoLimit identifies evaluation on X with restriction followed by the discrete limit functor; projection equations prove its naturality.

Products of abelian groups are exact [lem-pc-abelian-groups-exact-products], implemented by Mathlib.Algebra.Category.Grp.AB. Therefore the discrete limit functor preserves finite colimits as well as finite limits. Transfer both preservation properties through the natural isomorphism. Functor.preservesHomologyOfExact then gives the assertion, also for the empty indexing family.

proof_origin.place: Step 2; formalization through Mathlib exact products, written during second reading by H1
